thread:
maya: Heads-up — noticed SDK doesn't expose the /models/{id}/versions REST endpoint. I needed to list model variants in the onboarding sample app.

sam: Ah — we only surfaced model listing as `client.models.list()` but no versions method. Is this breaking your flow?

maya: Yeah. Sample app calls the REST endpoint for versions in onboarding script. UX: can't pin a specific model version via SDK. Also retry behavior differs: REST returns 429 and our fetch wrapper retries with exponential backoff, SDK returns 429 and surfaces error without retry.

raj: Hmm, SDK should centralize retry logic. Which SDK language?

maya: JS v0.8.2.

sam: Thanks. Quick reproduction?

maya: Paste:
```js
// using REST
await fetch('/v1/models/abc/versions');
// works, 429 -> retried by common-fetch and succeeds

// using SDK
await client.models.getVersions('abc');
// throws 429, no retry
```

liz: This would block PLG onboarding; devs expect parity. Can we add versions method or document a workaround?

raj: We'll triage. Two work items: 1) Add models.getVersions to JS SDK. 2) Align retry policy for 429/503 with REST (exponential backoff, jitter). I'll own the retry patch.

sam: Also check auth header handling: REST refreshes tokens via refresh_token flow in shared fetch middleware; SDK uses static token from env and doesn't refresh. That explains certain 401s after expiry.

maya: Yep — onboarding saw token expiry after ~1hr. Flow: redirect to login -> token rotated by browser -> REST picks new cookie but SDK uses env var.

raj: Ok plan: short-term doc in sample app, note to use REST for version listing + token refresh. Long-term: SDK patch and add tests + e2e.

sam: I'll open a GH issue + PR template. Anyone want to write the sample app doc change? @maya

maya: I can. Will include code snippets and warnings.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for `sdk-js` branch retry-policy-fix

liz: Thanks all. Let's sync in tomorrow standup if needed :thumbsup:
